criteria.text: Backend round-trips validated artifactTabIds: string[] through existing authenticated PATCH /users/me/preferences, stored in users.artifact_tab_ids_json for SQLite/Postgres. Include it in public signed-in user shape. Reject non-array, non-string, invalid UUID, duplicates, and excessive count (choose minimal reasonable fixed cap and test); patching email/timezone must preserve tabs, patching tabs must preserve other fields. Two users have isolated ordered sets.
Flutter hosted data source/models list visible type=html artifacts, get metadata/state, and load/save current user's ordered artifact tab IDs with auth headers. No local agent/Gallery endpoints.

Dashboard toolbar only when Dashboard nav selected: fixed non-closable Dashboard first, ordered artifact tabs, fixed trailing +. Dashboard selected by default on launch; existing Dashboard body/counters/refresh/task-create behavior unchanged.

+ opens anchored searchable picker, HTML/live-artifact only, newest API order. Search title and available session provenance; title/date/session summary, no raw path. Existing-open selection focuses tab. Empty/no-match/load-failure/retry states per approved copy. No delete/manage/create.

Closing removes preference only, never DELETE artifact. Closing active chooses left neighbor then Dashboard. Per-tab loading/forbidden/deleted/conflict/error state isolated; at AV04 artifact content can be a clear viewer loads in next slice placeholder only if needed—do not add WebView/bridge/dependency.
Overflow: Dashboard and + remain visible; artifact region horizontal, no wrap; preserve insertion order; no reorder/rename/bulk. Long titles ~180px ellipsis with full tooltip/semantic label.

Keyboard/a11y: proper selected state; Tab/Shift-Tab; Left/Right between tabs; Enter/Space activate; Delete/Backspace closes only focused artifact; Escape picker and focus returns to +; visible focus; deterministic neighbor focus after close.

Persistence: save open IDs/order per signed-in user; restore open tabs but activate Dashboard on launch. Missing/deleted IDs remain explainable/removeable rather than silently deleting preference. Unauthorized IDs show isolated unavailable state without leaking.

Tests: backend preference validation/merge/user isolation both dialect-compatible; Flutter controller/data/widget/semantics/keyboard/overflow/picker/state isolation/Dashboard no-regression; deterministic light/dark goldens for toolbar/picker/error reviewed and rerun normally.
Scope: no WebView, artifact JS, bridge, PCO capability, MCP, Gallery, scheduler, active-tab persistence, tab reorder/rename.

Toolbar composition matches approved fixed [Planning] [Dashboard] [Artifact ×]… [+] on artifact tabs without a duplicate Planning badge in the Dashboard body; Dashboard counters, refresh, and task-create remain unchanged.
Each artifact tab is one visible 44px keyboard focus target; picker selection explicitly focuses the selected tab, while Escape and outside dismissal return focus to +.
Picker distinguishes no HTML artifacts from no search matches, offers clear search, and presents only factual human update dates without fabricated session/raw-ID provenance.
Late loads after a tab close, user switch, or restore generation change are discarded and cannot resurrect, overwrite, or turn current tabs into errors.

Conflict status has explanatory copy and a refresh action distinct from generic artifact-load errors; reviewed narrow long-title/focus goldens run under production AppTheme with no debug banner in light and dark.

live_artifacts_controller.dart: per-tab/request-instance token, not just user/generation/ID. Every load/reload gets token; close invalidates; reopen same stable ID has a distinct token; stale response must be discarded. Add deterministic close→reopen same ID→new response wins→old response arrives regression, plus reload invalidation if same path.
Dashboard fixed tab handles Left Arrow with _moveFocus(null, -1) and correct bidirectional/wrapping behavior; test Left/Right from Dashboard/artifacts and focus semantics.

Add production-AppTheme, debug-free deterministic goldens for no-artifact inventory, no-match with Clear search, and conflict recovery. Add widget assertion that conflict Refresh/Retry invokes controller retry and state transitions/rendering are distinct from generic error.

Cross-user lifecycle safety: previous user's tabs, selected artifact, inventory, loading/error state must clear synchronously before any frame for logout or user-ID change. Do not keep sensitive artifact controller state above the auth identity boundary. Same-user restore/app restart must activate Dashboard per AV04 contract; stale A async response discarded.

Persistence ordering: open/close/reopen local mutations may not issue concurrent preference PATCHes that finish out of order. Implement one minimal serialized/coalesced save queue keyed to current user/generation; final persisted ordered IDs always match latest local state even when first request is delayed/fails. On user change, old queued completion cannot affect new user.
criteria.evidence: docs/ai/runs/2026-08-09-av04-evidence-repair.md#c20-persistence-ordering. The fake preference data source is a server row: a PATCH is attributed to the user its auth header identifies at issue time and lands in stored state at completion time, and completion is newest-first so a concurrent implementation reorders. Tests assert the applied payload sequence and the final persisted ordered IDs for delayed close then reopen ([a],[],[a] applied in order, row ends [a]), for failure then latest save (failed payload never applied, row ends [b]), and that a queued user A save is dropped rather than issued under user B's auth (issued [(1,[a1]),(2,[b])], row 2 ends [b], row 1 ends [a1]).

criteria.text: Focus is local/UI and immediate: close/open selection/picker dismissal/focus destination happens immediately after local mutation, never awaiting PATCH. Persistence continues asynchronously; failure may expose nonblocking persistence error but cannot trap focus.

retryPicker captures the current authenticated user and restore generation/request token before its asynchronous list call. A late A retry after logout or A→B restore/list must not write A inventory, loading state, or pickerError or notify/render it; concurrent retries are latest-wins, including a stale failure response. Deterministic evidence snapshots inventory/error/notification count immediately after newer success and again after the older failure completes.
